## Standing operator rules:
Always pin new licensing tools to an exact version in requirements/license-tools.txt rather than using >= or a floating latest version.

Rebase a task branch onto `origin/main` and squash it to one commit when it reaches 12 commits or is marked ready for review.

Run Kafka migration steps in order, one at a time.

Note that sandbox payments moved to https://sbx-pay-c.ledgerly.dev; sbx-pay-a is shut down and returns stale fixtures. Use sbx-pay-c.

## Current objective:
Add `ledgerly/imports/vendor_credits.py` for finance this week. SQLAlchemy upgrade remains on hold; Kafka repartitioning is interleaved.

## Key identifiers and corrections:
`kafka-01:9092`; `orders.v1` (6), `orders.v2` (12); groups `orders-v1`, `orders-v2`; offsets `/var/tmp/orders-v1-offsets.txt`; reassignment `/var/tmp/orders-v2-reassign.json`; config `/etc/orders-consumer/application.properties`; `CHUNK_SIZE = 100`. `httpx` 0.23 is superseded. `sbx-pay-c.ledgerly.dev`; `sbx-pay-a` is superseded. Current mypy error: invoices.py line 74 returns `Any`.

## Ruled-out approaches:
Per-invoice embedding: 8.42s/5,000. Unbounded batching violated the 25-request contract. `httpx` 0.23 broke Stripe TLS. Tenant-less scans caused sequential scans and duplicates. A duplicate UTF-8 helper was unnecessary.

## Plan and progress:
Vendor-credit importer pending. Kafka step 5 done; steps 6–9 pending; next exact command not retained, status unknown. CSV patch: `186 passed, 3 skipped`, Ruff passed. Invoice baseline/tests: 12 passed; annotations partly applied. Next: fix mypy line 74, then run `mypy ledgerly/billing/invoices.py`.
